d: Kendall, James, Logan and Carlos are hockey playing best friends from Minnesota, whose lives are turned upside down after mega-record producer discovers them and moves them to Los Angeles to make them into the next big boy band.

Kendall, Carlos, James, and Logan are required to attend four hours at school. However, instead of going to school at the Palmwoods Hotel, which they all have their own fantasies about, Gustavo insists that they attend school at his recording studio.
After Bellview High nerd, Eric Blonnowitz accidentally punches Drake he finds a newfound world of fame, popularity and girls.
After Drake and Josh accidentally kill Megan's pet hamster, they ready themselves for her revenge that could come anywhere, anytime.

After the boys get in trouble for using Fake ID's Audrey and Walter fear they will fall to a life of crime and sign them up for a "Steered Straight" program, but things start skidding out-of-control when a real criminal befriends them
Megan's been extremely secretive and Drake and Josh investigate to find out what she's up to.
The most popular kid in school is throwing what may be the greatest sixteenth party ever, but Drake and Josh may be having cake for two after they get banned from the party.

After Josh ruins Drake's chances at having a hit song in the Superbowl, the boys must find a way to make things right.   Along for the ride are a crazy houseguest, a  bride, and one really big shrimp.
In an effort to build understanding of what everyone does, Max assigns the staff to do a different job for the day.

True Jackson has a passion for fashion. She gets the chance of a lifetime when she's hired as the VP for a major fashion label.  The problem? Her new coworkers are not too thrilled to have a 15 year old as their boss.
Lulu's boyfriend has a party, but True is too busy to go.
True gets a temporary assistant for the week: her science teacher.
The Rockmores get a brand new television set.  Kel breaks the new TV that Chris was planning on raffling off at Rigby's, so Kenan pulls the old switcheroo.
There's a new girl in school, Becky.  Kel thinks he's head-over-heels in love with her.  Kenan thinks she's a witch and is determined to prove it.
Kenan's new neighbor, the nerdy Marc Cram, loves collecting watches.  Wouldn't you know it -- Kenan's watch goes missing!
Marc Cram is having a birthday bash and has invited everyone, except Kenan.  Kenan is determined to be in attendance at the party, one way or another.
The four 'hockey heads' need some home improvement for their new apartment, despite the objections of Reginald Bitters, the Palm Woods manager.
The guys get a dose of reality when Gustavo tells them they have to go to school while they live in Los Angeles.

The record company CEO thinks adding a fifth band member will broaden Big Time Rush’s appeal and sticks the guys with a self-proclaimed 'bad boy', who tries to inject dissension and tension within the group.
The guys all chase the same girl, causing problems in the band for the first time.
Drake wins a free skydive off a helicopter and goes off to do it despite his parents saying no.   Josh, being the good brother he is, tries to stop him, but ends up going along for the ride.
Blessed with his unconventional dance moves, Josh decides to try out for the local dance contest.
Worlds collide when Drake Parker and Josh Nichols, two very different kids attending the same high school, discover that they're about to become stepbrothers.
Drake and Josh get a Dune Buggy that Trevor brought to their house fixed and want to take it out for a spin, but Audrey and Walter think other ways.
After meeting Susan, Drake's new girlfriend, Josh becomes convinced that her flirtation is more than friendly behavior.

Kenan and Kel take an I.Q. test and Kel scores higher than Kenan.  When the guys go to talk to Principal Dimly about the test, Kel accidentally leaves incriminating evidence in the office.
While Kenan and Kel are in Kenan's room playing Penguin Hunter, the Rockmore's house is robbed.  Kenan and Kel try and stall his parents from coming home before they can see what has happened.
Roger is planning a surprise anniversary party for Sheryl. Too bad Kenan and Kel are in charge of picking up the cake and Sheryl's gift.
There's a rat loose in Rigby's.  It's up to Kenan and Kel to capture it before the exterminator gets to the rat.
